crossRefs.note: When they had brought their boats to land, they left everything, and followed him.
He said to another, “Follow me!” But he said, “Lord, allow me first to go and bury my father.”
So he departed from there, and found Elisha the son of Shaphat, who was plowing with twelve yoke of oxen before him…
But when the young man heard the saying, he went away sad, for he was one who had great possessions.

translations.web: He left everything, and rose up and followed him.
translations.bsb: and Levi got up, left everything, and followed Him.
translations.kjv: And he left all, rose up, and followed him.
translations.asv: And he forsook all, and rose up and followed him.
